decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w9' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8964. Series context: trend strength 1.0 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.329); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.074.
